title: Simulating surveys from catalogs to cosmology with Euclid, SPT, and UNIONS
author: Cail Daley
description: Mocks and forward models from catalogs to cosmology, through a Euclid × SPT-3G 6×2pt analysis and a new UNIONS shape catalog.

sections.title: Simulating surveys
sections.outline: An overview of the three parts and what unites them; the tensions that appear in ΛCDM when probes are combined, new physics or systematics; mocks that reproduce a survey to validate pipelines; simulations from cheap to realistic, with forward models for inference at the realistic end.

sections.title: Euclid × SPT-3G
sections.outline: Euclid shear and clustering crossed with SPT-3G CMB lensing: the overlap, the pipeline and its mocks, the blinded TR1 data vector, and blinded posteriors against ACT DR6.

sections.title: UNIONS
sections.outline: The first UNIONS cosmic-shear release over 3,500 deg², the new 191-million-galaxy shape catalog over 5,200 deg² and the tomographic cosmic shear and 3×2pt with SPHEREx it feeds.

sections.title: Doing science now
sections.outline: Simulations as a verifiable environment for agents, Lightcone with a live demonstration, simulation-based inference as the work proposed for ICE, the questions this puts to the community, and a summary.

sections.title: Backup
sections.outline: The DR1 blinding tests, how a shift is drawn and whether it is recovered, the lens ratio as a check on shear calibration, the systematics-template crosses and the FLASK covariance; the UNIONS first-release S8, B-modes, mock comparison and blinding, the v2 error bars, robustness tests, contours and the IA prior; the earlier opening and close on how collaborations work.
